name: Sanctuary denied sensitive operation
description: Flags denied Sanctuary audit events for identity, state deletion, or reputation import operations. The decision is read from sanctuary.audit.decision so ECS event.type remains the ECS 8.11.0 configuration/info pairing.
query: event.dataset: sanctuary.audit and sanctuary.audit.decision: deny and event.action: (identity_sign or state_delete or reputation_import)

name: Sanctuary deny burst
description: Threshold rule for five or more denied events for the same operation in five minutes. The threshold field is event.action so one operation's burst is grouped without alerting on every single deny.

name: Sanctuary failed audit operation
description: Flags Sanctuary audit operations whose producer result is failure.
